candidate.original_question: According to the passage, what happens if he is so disqualified by or under any law made by Parliament. 2[Explanation.—For the purposes of this clause]?
candidate.original_answer:
if he is so disqualified by or under any law made by Parliament.
      2[Explanation.—For the purposes of this clause], a person shall not be
deemed to hold an office of profit under the Government of India or the
Government of any State specified in the First Schedule by reason only that he
is a Minister either for the Union or for such State.
candidate.proposed_question: What does the Explanation to Article 191(1) say about a person being a Minister?
candidate.proposed_answer: A person is not deemed to hold an office of profit under the Government of India or a State specified in the First Schedule only because that person is a Minister for the Union or that State.
candidate.source_text_finding: The Explanation to Article 191(1) states that a person is not deemed to hold the specified office of profit merely because the person is a Minister for the Union or the relevant State.
